name: Fundamentals
description: Core Next.js concepts, framework overview, architecture, benefits, comparisons with React, and use cases.

name: Routing
description: File-system routing, dynamic routes, nested routes, route groups, parallel routes, intercepting routes, and routing concepts.

name: Navigation
description: Link component, useRouter, redirects, navigation APIs, client navigation, and route transitions.

name: App Router vs Pages Router
description: Differences, migration strategies, feature comparison, compatibility, and architectural changes between routing systems.

name: Server & Client Components
description: Server Components, Client Components, rendering boundaries, directives, composition, and communication between component types.

name: Rendering & Data Fetching
description: SSR, SSG, ISR, CSR, static and dynamic rendering, fetch(), data loading strategies, and rendering lifecycle.

name: Loading, Error Handling & Streaming
description: loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found.tsx, Suspense, streaming, error boundaries, and fallback UI.

name: API Routes, Route Handlers & Server Actions
description: API Routes, Route Handlers, Server Actions, backend functionality, mutations, forms, and server-side logic.

name: Caching
description: Data Cache, Full Route Cache, Router Cache, cache invalidation, revalidation, cache tags, and caching strategies.

name: Performance & SEO
description: Performance optimization, hydration, metadata, image optimization, fonts, scripts, SEO, Core Web Vitals, and optimization techniques.

name: Styling & Configuration
description: CSS Modules, Tailwind CSS, Sass, global styles, configuration files, environment variables, TypeScript setup, and project configuration.

name: State Management, Security & Cookies
description: State management approaches, authentication, authorization, cookies, headers, middleware security, sessions, and request handling.

name: Architecture, Testing, i18n & Deployment
description: Project structure, architectural patterns, testing, internationalization, deployment, Vercel, Docker, and production best practices.

name: Other
description: Questions that do not clearly belong to any category above.
